name: Clarinet
summary: Small Melbourne ISP founded 1994 (Clarinet Internet Solutions Pty Ltd, Kew/Oakleigh/Lilydale VIC, ACN 074 592 877): dialup, connectivity and hosting for business and home customers, later VPS/dedicated servers and Linux/FreeBSD consulting (clari.net.au). Sister telephony arm Clarinet (AUST) / Clarinet Australia (clarinet.com.au) provided VoIP services from the mid-2000s. Still trading as a hosting and internet-solutions provider.

events.details: Founded 1994 (company-profile databases); self-described 'small Internet Service Provider located in Melbourne Australia ... connectivity and hosting services to both business and home customers. With over 15 years of experience in commercial internet provision.' Owner: Daniel O'Callaghan.
